instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Its name means something like share the journey, not the noise. Just because we're in the same carriage, doesn't mean we've joined the fan club for the same video. The words draw that line simply. This isn't saying don't enjoy yourself, it's more like saying choose who hears the sound. You can enjoy videos and music, just don't make people around you sit in the audience without asking them. Headphones don't take away your entertainment, they're a small screen that keeps the fun in your own seat. The next time you press play, take a breath. Who am I sending this sound to? We're on the same train, going the same way, still the sound doesn't have to ride into everyone else's ears.
